expectedUsable: Each FAQ question can be expanded/collapsed with the keyboard (Enter or Space) once focused, not just by mouse click.

violations.expectedFix: Use a native <button>, or add a keydown handler that activates on Enter and Space, so the accordion is operable by keyboard as well as mouse.
violations.notes: role=button + tabindex=0 makes each header focusable with a valid name, so axe reports no violation. But activation is wired to onclick only; Enter/Space do nothing, so keyboard users can't open any answer. Layer B catches this by simulating key activation and observing no state change.
